The '''bogwing''' was a flying [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]]<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref> It was very territorial and used its talons to pick up victims. It could carry up to nine times its own weight.<ref name="Card-CCG-Bog-wing Dark">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Bog-wing (Dark)}}</ref> Bogwings did not hatch from eggs but were born live. As bogwings spent most of their lives in flight, this resulted in the newborns being required to learn to fly immediately during the free-fall of their birth. Juvenile bogwings learned to hunt by watching older bogwings and would generally flock under the flightpath of successful hunters to eat any scraps the individual may drop in flight.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 4">{{FactFile|4|DAG 1-4|Dagobah}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], bogwings were seen in the valleys of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] had imprisoned a number of hostile bogwing specimens in their statis [[The Tomb|tomb prisons]] on the world. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Imperial forces released multiple imprisoned beasts, including the bogwings. During this same period, the Republic attempted training bogwings to carry supplies and munitions to remote military squads. Unfortunately, the creatures proved temperamental and dangerous to handle, so the concept was not widely implemented.<ref name="swtor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Bogwings were released by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to signal half-time at [[Gulliball/Legends|Gulliball]] games.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> Bogwings were also found on [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]<ref name="Mercy Mission episode">{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}</ref> and [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

There were two races of bogwings: the greater bogwing and the lesser bogwing.<ref name="NoP" /> They both fed on small creatures dwelling in the canopy, but the greater bogwing fed in the upper levels, while the lesser bogwing fed on the lower levels where it avoided larger predators such as the [[Jubba bird/Legends|jubba bird]].<ref name=":0" />
